record.scope_reason: EXPERT is a general image-caption evaluation metric. Physical page 3 uses Flickr8k-Expert/CF, COMPOSITE, Polaris, Nebula and Pascal50S, with no biomedical imagery or clinical reporting task.

record.title: Mind Your Theory: Theory of Mind Goes Deeper Than Reasoning
record.scope_reason: The theory-of-mind position and empirical study targets model belief inference. Physical pages 4–5 evaluate task-order effects for GPT models on HiToM and FANToM false-belief tasks. Cognitive/neuroscientific framing is not a clinical population, disorder assessment or biomedical-primary experiment.

record.title: LLMs are Biased Evaluators But Not Biased for Fact-Centric Retrieval Augmented Generation
record.scope_reason: The complete abstracts study self-preference bias in general RAG on Natural Questions, MS MARCO and TriviaQA, not biomedical retrieval or clinical evidence.

record.title: Standard Quality Criteria Derived from Current NLP Evaluations for Guiding Evaluation Design and Grounding Comparability and AI Compliance Assessments
record.scope_reason: QCET studies NLP evaluation methodology. Physical page 3 derives 114 quality criteria from 933 evaluation experiments across NLP tasks and modalities. Its target is formal task-agnostic evaluation quality, not medical evaluation.

record.title: skLEP: A Slovak General Language Understanding Benchmark
record.scope_reason: skLEP is a Slovak language understanding benchmark. Physical pages 2–4 document nine generic tasks on dependencies, named entities, textual entailment, inference, similarity, hate speech, sentiment and Wikipedia QA. No biomedical-primary corpus or outcome.

record.title: Can Vision Language Models Understand Mimed Actions?
record.scope_reason: MIME evaluates understanding of mimed gestures. Physical pages 2–3 describe motion capture of two actors, 47 action types and 86 samples rendered with background and viewpoint perturbations. Apraxia is mentioned as context, but the actual study does not recruit affected patients or test a clinical outcome.

record.title: Training Language Model to Critique for Better Refinement
record.scope_reason: RCO optimizes general self-critiques. Physical pages 4–5 describe five tasks and fourteen training datasets, evaluated on BBH, GPQA, MMLU variants, TruthfulQA, MATH, GSM8K and MBPP. Medical knowledge among broad benchmark subjects is not a biomedical-primary study.

record.title: Dynamic Task Vector Grouping for Efficient Multi-Task Prompt Tuning
record.scope_reason: DTVG transfers soft prompts across general NLU tasks. Physical pages 5–6 and 15–16 describe 26 datasets from GLUE, SuperGLUE, MRQA and additional Winogrande, Yelp, SciTail and PAWS tasks; source tasks include MNLI, QNLI, QQP, SST2, ReCoRD and SQuAD. The main problem and evidence are not biomedical.

record.title: DICE-BENCH: Evaluating the Tool-Use Capabilities of Large Language Models in Multi-Round, Multi-Party Dialogues
record.scope_reason: DICE-BENCH assesses tool-augmented assistants in everyday interactions. Physical pages 3–4 specify 124 tools, 270 dependency edges and 1607 synthetic dialogues in weather, hotel, restaurant and calendar scenarios, not healthcare tool use.

record.title: HASH-RAG: Bridging Deep Hashing with Retriever for Efficient, Fine Retrieval and Augmented Generation
record.scope_reason: HashRAG addresses general retrieval generation on Natural Questions, TriviaQA and HotpotQA, as established by both complete abstracts. No biomedical-primary research task.

record.title: A Constrained Text Revision Agent via Iterative Planning and Searching
record.scope_reason: The final PDF CRAFT/CORD study addresses constrained text revision. Physical pages 2–3 and 6 show TETRA preliminary experiments and 500 texts spanning academic writing, WikiHow and human stories; constraint groups C0–C4 vary revision constraints, not health domains. The HTML instead names TRIPS/ConsTRev, retained as a substantive version difference.

record.title: MMRefine: Unveiling the Obstacles to Robust Refinement in Multimodal Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: MMRefine studies multimodal mathematical error localization and refinement. Physical page 3 uses 100 MathOdyssey plus 100 MathVision problems and 800 solutions. It does not study medical images or clinical errors.

record.title: How Programming Concepts and Neurons Are Shared in Code Language Models
record.scope_reason: The paper studies programming-language-specific neurons in code language models; neurons are artificial model components. Both complete abstracts concern programming representation and code tasks, not biological neurons or biomedical research.

record.scope_reason: DynaQuest is general dynamic QA. Physical pages 3–4 construct 1.98 million questions from Wikipedia across 88 infobox types, including country and person facts and time-changing news knowledge. No biomedical-primary knowledge task.

record.reason: ProcrustesGPT compresses general language-model weight matrices through orthogonal transformations and structured matrix approximation. No biomedical-primary task in complete abstract.
